name: The Monster Reapers
summary:
Enter a world full of monsters in The Monster Reapers.
Pick up your weapons and become the best gunslinger in this single-player and cooperative action shooter.
Fight in different universes and defend yourself against hordes of horrible creatures.

- 2 MAPS ARE AVAILABLE TO YOU :
Fight on a beach and a cemetery.

- RELOAD LIKE IN REAL LIFE :
Tilt your colts to the side to reload.

- USE TWO WEAPONS AT ONCE :
You can wield two weapons at the same time for twice the damage !

- BONUS CARDS :
Accumulate as man
